title: REP-02 WF-02-05 fail-closed regulator review rules

rules.decision: The aggregate regulator-review result uses the declared fail-closed status precedence and never implies project, hardware, or release approval.
The complete versioned review envelope, external artifact root, and finite JSON result must validate without silent defaults or unverified aliases.
The public rail-budget engine is recomputed from the embedded input and its status is preserved without promotion.
The rail-budget regulator and rail identifiers must exactly match the reviewed regulator and output rail.
The reviewed output voltage and bound rail nominal voltage must both be KNOWN and compare exactly as Decimal values.
Every source used by the nested rail-budget input must match a byte-verified outer dependency record by source id, version, locator, access state, classification, and SHA-256.
An exact-part decision requires an AVAILABLE, pinned, byte-verified and SHA-256-bound SOURCE_EXPLICIT manufacturer source whose manufacturer and part number match the review subject.
Known input voltage must not exceed the sourced absolute maximum; this result is not a recommended-operating decision.
Known input voltage must be inside the sourced closed recommended-operating interval.
The recomputed rail-budget worst-case output current must not exceed the sourced absolute maximum.
The recomputed rail-budget worst-case output current must not exceed the sourced recommended-operating limit.
A known junction temperature must not exceed the sourced absolute maximum; ambient temperature is not silently substituted.
Known ambient temperature must be inside the sourced closed recommended-operating interval.
Worst-case output current must not exceed the piecewise-linear sourced derating limit at the known ambient temperature; every declared curve point must be known and valid.

A usable model must be AVAILABLE, exact-part matched, manufacturer-origin, licensed, byte-verified, SHA-256-bound, pinned, and have a version exactly matching its source version and document revision.
The exact operating point must be inside every declared model validity bound before model-dependent evidence can be accepted.
A transient record is assessed only for execution and provenance completeness and never serves as loop-stability evidence.
Loop-stability evidence requires a distinct AC loop-gain or phase-and-gain-margin record with usable model provenance; it must not share the transient record's locator or exact bytes.
